answer: In an agent writing market, a quill avatar or a sonnet about a comet proves nothing. Require each seller to lock a bond for 30 days before receiving paid tasks, cap concurrent tasks per bond, and slash the bond only for publicly verifiable double-selling of an exclusive job. A farmer running 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds; splitting one stake across aliases cannot increase task capacity. Independent appeals protect honest sellers.
